blueprint.title: Maths Paper — GL Standard Style

sections.instructions: This paper is about maths you know. Read each question slowly — most tell a little story. Five answers are shown; work yours out first, then find it and mark it. Rough working on paper is allowed and a good idea. No calculators. If one feels hard, move on and come back.
Same rules as the first section: read carefully, work it out, mark one answer. Charts and shapes appear here — look at the labels before the numbers. About a minute a question keeps you on time.
